title: BRIO + IndoBART summarizer
problem: Abstractive summarization for Indonesian, where strong pretrained summarizers are scarce.
role: Sole researcher: adaptation, training runs and evaluation.
desc: My master's thesis adapts BRIO, a training method that teaches a summarizer to rank its own candidate summaries, to IndoBART for Indonesian text. The work covers fine-tuning, candidate generation and ROUGE-based evaluation. A write-up and code will be linked here when the thesis is complete.

title: Fitter Mobile
problem: Photograph a meal and get the food type and its nutritional value on your phone.
context: Mobile follow-up to Fitter · in development
desc: Fitter Mobile brings my earlier Fitter project to mobile. It recognizes the type of food in a photo and shows its nutritional value. Built with React Native, Expo and Firebase. The app is still in development; a prebuilt APK can be downloaded from the GitHub repository.

title: Dover
problem: Separate sea from land in optical satellite images.
desc: Sea–land segmentation based on superpixel Fuzzy C-Means clustering and a modified Chan–Vese model, applied to optical images. Built in Python with OpenCV and deployed as a Streamlit web app. A four-person project for the Computer Vision course.

title: Fitter
problem: Recognize a food from an image and estimate its nutritional value.
desc: Fitter is a deep learning model that recognizes the type of food in an image and estimates its nutritional value. A three-person final project for the Machine Learning course, with a Streamlit demo.

title: STEPCODE
problem: A coding-learning platform where learners choose a tutor based on their experience.
context: Team of 5 · Software Engineering course · Scrum
desc: STEPCODE helps people learn to code by letting each learner choose a tutor based on that tutor's experience. Built by a team of five for the Software Engineering course with TypeScript, React (Vite), Express and Firebase. The team worked in Scrum sprints with daily standups, sprint reviews and a designated Product Owner managing the backlog.

title: FarmByte
problem: Connect farmers, compost producers and restaurants to reduce food waste (SDG 12).
desc: FarmByte connects farmers, compost producers and restaurants so that produce and food waste move between them efficiently, in line with SDG 12 (Responsible Consumption and Production). Built with Laravel by a team of five for the Web Programming course.
